segmentation.text: Every person operating a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter
(a) When traveling at a lawful rate of speed
(c) When doing so would not be safe,
ride as near to the right side of the roadway
when passing a standing vehicle or one proceeding in the same direction.

For purposes of paragraph (c) of subsection 1, the conditions under which it is not safe to operate a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter as near to the right side of the roadway as practicable include, without limitation:
(a) When fixed or moving objects, parked or moving vehicles, bicycles, pedestrians, animals or surface hazards impede access to the right side of the roadway.
(b) When a lane is too narrow for a bicycle and a vehicle to travel safely side by side within the lane.

elements.justification: Admitted aggregates of the three defined terms, each one ru.aggregate atom ('membership of a legal aggregate'), never expanded; 'person operating' read through controlled motion (agency reading).

st.roadway, 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic, excluding shoulder', is the extent of DEF-NRS-484A-220; rel.occupies anchors the subject ('a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region'), as the index maps 'upon a roadway'. The exceptions 'except:' introduces qualify the keep-right duty (sibling spans, see PLAN).

'passing ... a vehicle' from the rear is drv.interaction.overtake_pass: 'Road user a overtakes and passes road user b from the rear: a, travelling in the same direction as b, comes from having b ahead of it to having b behind it'; its contract 'says nothing of ... whether b moves', so it covers a standing and a moving b. 'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle. 'standing' (DEF-NRS-484A-250, not an aggregate): 'the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, otherwise than for the purpose of and while actually engaged in receiving or discharging passengers', read as b at rest, drv.motion.complete_halt ('The road user is at rest at the observation'), the passenger purpose being unobservable (observable_reading purpose). 'one proceeding in the same direction' is b moving (kin.speed above the tolerance) with its heading aligned with the subject's (rel.same_direction, 'headings aligned').

operationalizations.convention: Due care is a standard of the rider's state of mind; it is bounded by the clearance kept while passing. At every observation of the pass at which the two bodies are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero) the bodies do not touch (rel.contact) and the lateral component of their body gap (rel.surface_gap) is at least p.door_swing_reach where the passed vehicle is at rest (the reach of a door opened into the rider's path) and at least p.bicycle_pass_safe_gap where it moves (the bicyclist's operating-space sway beyond its body width); the bound is selected by the passed vehicle's motion at each such observation.

applicability: The subject is a member of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter aggregate, and at the observation drv.interaction.overtake_pass(subject, b) is recognized (window p.overtake_window, heading tolerance p.overtake_same_direction_cos) for some road user b of the vehicle aggregate, the subject's footprint having overlapped a roadway at some observation since the act began.
obligation: For each such b: at every observation since the act began (the last observation of the window behind at which b was ahead of the subject with headings aligned) up to the recognition at which the two bodies are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero), rel.contact between the subject and b is false and the lateral component of rel.surface_gap is at least the clearance selected there: p.door_swing_reach where b is at rest (drv.motion.complete_halt, p.halt_speed_tolerance), p.bicycle_pass_safe_gap where b moves with its heading aligned with the subject's (rel.same_direction, p.overtake_same_direction_cos). Surrogate: the verdict is evidence of care, not a legal conclusion.

narrowings.why: 'person operating' is read through the device's controlled motion, whoever controls it.
'standing' is read as the passed vehicle at rest: the definition's exclusion of a halt for receiving or discharging passengers turns on a purpose no atom observes, so every halt is read as standing.
Due care, the whole obligation, is read only as the clearance kept and the absence of contact while alongside the passed vehicle; the rider's attention and its speed while passing are not read.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle on a roadway overtakes and passes a car of the vehicle aggregate parked at the curb (at rest throughout), keeping a lateral body gap of 0.4 m while alongside it.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the bicycle keeps a lateral body gap of 1.5 m while alongside the parked car.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle rides alone along a roadway and passes no road user: no pass is recognized.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the source does not observe the gap between bodies.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle on a roadway passes a car moving slowly the same way, keeping a lateral body gap of 1.2 m while alongside it.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle on a roadway passes a car moving slowly the same way, touching its mirror while alongside it.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle rides on a separate path beside the roadway as the pass of a parked car begins and moves onto the roadway part way through the pass, keeping a lateral body gap of 0.4 m while alongside the car: the subject was on the roadway at some observation of the pass.

scenarios.name: branch_4
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle rides on the roadway, then moves onto a separate path off the roadway before the parked car comes ahead of it, and passes the car from the path with a lateral body gap of 0.4 m: it was on the roadway only before the pass began.

param_proposals.name: p.door_swing_reach
param_proposals.convention: lateral reach of an open passenger-car side door beyond the vehicle body (a front door opens about 0.9 to 1.1 m)
param_proposals.source: passenger-car door dimensions (door-zone guidance for bicyclists)

param_proposals.name: p.bicycle_pass_safe_gap
param_proposals.convention: the lateral clearance between the body of a passing motor vehicle and a bicyclist's: the bicyclist's operating-space sway beyond its body width, about one metre of free space beside it
param_proposals.source: AASHTO Guide for the Development of Bicycle Facilities (bicyclist operating space)

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: sensor speed resolution of the acquisition standard

param_proposals.name: p.overtake_window
param_proposals.convention: the longest duration of an overtaking manoeuvre on an urban street, from having the overtaken vehicle ahead to having it behind

param_proposals.name: p.overtake_same_direction_cos
param_proposals.convention: cosine of the largest heading difference (about 25 degrees) at which two vehicles count as travelling in the same direction while one moves out to pass the other
